title: Quantitative Convergence of Markov Equilibria for Time-Inconsistent Controlled Diffusions
summary: Time-inconsistent stochastic control admits a natural game-theoretic interpretation in which successive decision dates are represented by different selves. In the Markovian framework of Björk-Khapko-Murgoci, the corresponding continuous-time equilibrium HJB system can be motivated by discrete subgame-perfect games, but the general discrete-to-continuous passage is not automatic. We establish a quantitative convergence theorem for a smooth uniformly elliptic class with strongly concave Hamiltonians and interior equilibrium controls, allowing control in both drift and diffusion.
